children: Michael A. Skinner, a director of Rainmaker Worldwide Inc., disclosed a 6.2% stake in the company’s common stock. He filed the Schedule 13D on Sep. 11, 2026, after receiving stock for accrued dividends on Sep. 2 and making recent open-market purchases. The position includes shares he can immediately obtain by converting Series A Preferred Stock.

Skinner holds the stake for investment. He can increase his position by converting Series A Preferred Stock that is immediately convertible. He states he has "no present plans or proposals" for actions like mergers, asset sales, or board changes, but he may buy more or sell shares over time.

Michael A. Skinner is a Canadian businessman and corporate executive. He serves as a director of Rainmaker Worldwide Inc. and is the principal of MAS Capital Inc. and Kawartha Entertainment Group Inc. He invests through these wholly owned entities and focuses on building positions in companies where he is closely involved.
